title: 小宇航员的星际糖果星

meta.style: 3D Pixar animation style, vibrant pastel colors, soft cinematic lighting, dreamlike, 8k

character_refs.name: 小宇航员泡泡
character_refs.description: A cute 6-year-old chibi astronaut boy, round glass helmet, big sparkling brown eyes, wearing a puffy white and teal spacesuit with glowing buttons

shots.voiceover: 在银河系的最深处，藏着一颗彩虹色的棉花糖星球！
shots.visual_prompt: A cute round spaceship flying towards a giant swirling rainbow cotton candy planet in deep space, glowing stars, 3D Pixar style, 9:16 vertical

shots.voiceover: 小宇航员泡泡推开舱门，哇！地上的石头居然全是跳跳糖！
shots.visual_prompt: Paopao the cute chibi astronaut stepping out of spaceship onto glowing sparkling candy crystals ground, looking around in wonder, 3D Pixar style, 9:16 vertical

shots.voiceover: 一只果冻小兔子跳了过来，送给他一颗会发光的棒棒糖。
shots.visual_prompt: A translucent glowing jelly bunny hopping towards Paopao the chibi astronaut and offering a spinning galaxy lollipop, magical particle effects, 3D Pixar style, 9:16 vertical

shots.voiceover: 轻轻咬上一口，整片夜空都绽放出了七彩的糖果烟花！
shots.visual_prompt: Paopao the chibi astronaut tasting the lollipop with a joyful smile, colorful candy fireworks exploding in the night sky, vibrant reflections, 3D Pixar style, 9:16 vertical

shots.voiceover: 今晚的梦里，你也会收到一份宇宙送来的甜蜜礼物哦！
shots.visual_prompt: The cute spaceship flying away gently through a sea of glowing stars and candy dust, warm cozy sunset lighting, 3D Pixar style, 9:16 vertical
